title: Detail layout
summary: A record-detail page's body: main content and a sticky sidebar of summary cards, sized minmax(0, 1fr) plus a fixed sidebar width. Below a container width (not the viewport, so it works next to a side nav or inside a narrower pane) it collapses to one column; sidebarFirst puts the sidebar above the main content once collapsed, and sidebarTwoUp lays its own cards two-up instead of stacking one-per-row. Elements carrying data-pk-section are grouped into phone tabs once collapsed.

props.name: sidebarFirst
props.description: Once collapsed to one column, the sidebar comes before the main content instead of after.

props.name: sidebarTwoUp
props.description: Once collapsed to one column, the sidebar's own cards lay out two per row instead of stacking one-per-row.

props.name: section
props.description: The selected section once the layout has collapsed to one column and its cards name two or more data-pk-section values. Empty selects the first section.

props.name: nextLabel
props.description: The text before the next section's name on the button after the main column ("Next: Pricing").

slots.name: sidebar
slots.description: Summary/status cards; pk-card fits. Sticky in the two-column layout: it sticks by its top edge, or by its bottom edge when it is taller than the viewport, so every card can be reached.

events.name: pk-section-change
events.description: The user chose a section, with a tab, the Next button, or by submitting a form whose invalid control was in a hidden section. Cancelable: preventDefault keeps the previous section.

parts.name: tabs
parts.description: The pk-tabs strip of sections (collapsed layout with two or more sections only)

parts.name: next
parts.description: The button to the next section

cssProperties.name: --pk-detail-layout-sidebar
cssProperties.description: Sidebar column width in the two-column layout.

cssProperties.name: --pk-detail-layout-main-max
cssProperties.description: Maximum width of the main column. The sidebar stays flush right in the content area, so a capped main column does not pull it inward.

cssProperties.name: --pk-detail-layout-height
cssProperties.description: Set by the element on the sidebar part: its measured height, used to dock a sidebar taller than the viewport by its bottom edge. Not for authors to set.

a11y: A layout primitive only: no landmark or role of its own. Give the main content and the sidebar their own headings so assistive technology can navigate between them.
mobile: Below the container's own 48rem, not the viewport: one column, the sidebar no longer sticky (in the two-column layout it docks by its bottom edge when taller than the viewport), in document order unless sidebarFirst. Elements inside it that carry data-pk-section (optionally data-pk-section-label on the first of a section) become tabs on a pk-tabs strip when there are two or more sections: only the selected section shows, a Next button moves on, and a required control in a hidden section is revealed when the form is submitted.

writes.target: elements inside the layout that carry data-pk-section
writes.why: While the layout is collapsed and tabbed, every element outside the selected section gets the marker data-pk-section-hidden, and display: none is set through CSSOM (no attribute); both are removed again when the layout widens, loses its sections or the section is selected. Kept when the element disconnects.
